# tmux-claude-bot

tmux-claude-bot runs Claude Code and Codex agents inside managed sessions and lets users
control them from Telegram, Feishu/Lark, a local CLI, or the terminal UI.

## Primary Documentation

- [Documentation map](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/README.md): Maintained documentation inventory, source-of-truth categories, and cleanup rules.
- [User manual](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/manual.md): Complete user guide for install, setup, chat usage, CLI usage, autopilot, and batch scheduling.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): Maintained `tcb` command, subcommand, and option surface.
- [Chat command reference](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/commands.md): Telegram and Feishu/Lark command list and behavior.
- [Terminal UI guide](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/tui.md): `tcb tui` layout, keys, and workflows.
- [AI usage guide](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/agents/usage-guide.md): Task recipes for assistants helping a user operate tmux-claude-bot.
- [Intelligent automation map](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/intelligent-automation.md): Terms, relationships, task families, supervisor gates, and maintenance rules for Loop Engineering, Autopilot, Opportunity Discovery, PR review, and Daily Task Audit.
- [Intelligent automation architecture](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/intelligent-automation-architecture.md): End-to-end architecture, session model, WorkOrder pipeline, system gates, and drift controls for the automation platform.
- [Intelligent automation ASCII architecture](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/intelligent-automation-ascii-architecture.md): Compact visual map of surfaces, sessions, WorkOrders, system gates, self-healing loops, and governance.
- [Automation alignment contract](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/automation-alignment.md): Rule placement, cross-surface parity matrix, drift audit checklist, and known alignment gaps for intelligent automation.
- [Automation capability matrix](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/automation-capability-matrix.md): Surface-by-surface support matrix for CLI, TUI, Telegram, Feishu/Lark, and the home/operator skill.
- [AI tool surface governance](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/ai-tool-surface-governance.md): Role-based governance for exposing tmux-claude-bot capabilities through CLI, MCP tools, and skills.
- [Testing standard](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md): Test strategy, local verification commands, and guardrails.

## Architecture And Maintenance

- [Architecture ADR](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-bot-architecture-refactor.md): Adapter/core/shared layering and bot architecture.
- [Protocol layering ADR](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-protocol-layering.md): Protocol boundaries across chat adapters and core behavior.
- [Multi-agent ADR](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-multi-agent-claude-and-codex.md): Claude/Codex agent support model.
- [Agent maintenance guidelines](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/tmux-claude-bot/blob/main/docs/agent-maintenance-guidelines.md): Detailed rules for service/runtime maintenance, logs, isolation, notifications, GitHub account usage, and verification.

## Guidance For AI Assistants

For user-facing usage questions, read `docs/agents/usage-guide.md` first, then follow
its links to `docs/manual.md`, `docs/commands.md`, and `docs/tui.md` for details. Do
not infer undocumented commands or flags from source code before checking the
documented references.
